notes: Capital One's April 14, 2026 announcement explicitly states that Spark Miles Select will now be known as VentureOne Business. This record preserves the predecessor brand and its historical terms; the announcement does not establish an exact withdrawal date. The former generic credit-card catalog source did not document this predecessor or its rebrand. Historical card artwork remains unverified; no successor artwork is used.
